rows.business_description:
Algorhythm (www.algorhythm.io) DBA Hello Insight is an “impact science” company that combines rigorous applied evaluation methods, next generation analytics, and real-time technologies to deliver accurate insights and actionable solutions to those working directly with children, youth and families.  Since our inception in 2013, Algorhythm DBA Hello Insight's overarching philosophy and approach are best characterized as utilization focused, applied and participatory, with a strong commitment to creating ongoing collaborative learning environments that foster the development of staff, programs, organizations, and fields of practice.  Our automated, online learning platform Hello Insight (www.helloinsight.org) equips out-of-school and in-school programs with research-based tools and analytics that have been tested and validated with nearly 1,000 peer organizations around the country.  These tools measure a wide range of research-based social and emotional learning (SEL) outcomes and positive youth development (PYD) practices for youth serving programs, including:

? Arts programs
? Camps
? Career Workforce Readiness programs 
? College Readiness programs
? Leadership programs
? Literacy programs
? Sports Based Youth Development (SBYD) programs
? Mentoring programs
? Writing programs
? Youth Leadership and Action (or Youth-led Social Change) programs

Hello Insight supports organizations and programs to:

? Share in a common set of valid and standardized metrics of social and emotional learning outcomes and positive youth development practices that have been developed with peer programs, staff and youth;
? Conduct a cost-effective program evaluation through a user-friendly online platform that offers surveys via any internet-accessible device or by paper surveys (also available in multiple languages);
? Understand youth assets and growth potential, at the beginning of programming;
? Access highly accurate predictive and prescriptive analytic models;
? Use data-driven PYD recommendations, generated by artificial intelligence (AI) technology, that leverage an ever-growing dataset to identify what has worked for youth with similar attributes;
? Access rigorously analyzed pre/post matched data, that highlight significant growth, and provide benchmarks;
? Communicate findings, insights and priority recommendations to various stakeholders, including: youth, families, staff, board members, and funders; and
? Contribute to and benefit from a rapidly growing shared dataset. As a collective, we share our findings locally, regionally and nationally and ignite national discussions to amplify the work of our partners and their learnings to support the larger youth development field.

Hello Insight is widely adopted, especially in New York City.  Algorhythm is a preferred assessment partner with the YMCA of the USA and is engaged with more than 200 Ys across the country.  In addition, numerous foundations and national membership organizations have supported local partners to participate in Hello Insight, for example:  NYC Service, The New York Community Trust, Youth INC, Vita Sports Partners/VITA Hub NYC, Laureus Sport for Good Foundation, The Chicago Cubs, The LA Dodgers Foundation, Camp Fire, BUILD, The Funders Collaborative on Youth Organizing (FCYO), Philadelphia Youth Sports Collaborative, Elma Philanthropies, and Newark Thrives. In partnership with NYU Metro Center (The Metropolitan Center for Research on Equity and the Transformation of Schools), our tools are currently being used as part of several, multi-year studies being supported by the W.T. Grant Foundation, Institute for Education Science (IES), and the Kellogg Foundation. 

Our founders and leadership team have more than fifty years of collective expertise and experience in providing applied research and evaluation services, especially in NYC, before creating Algorhythm.  In addition to the cost-effective Hello Insight measurement system, Algorhythm provides services, including: evaluation planning; logic model development; quantitative and qualitative tool development and analysis; participatory evaluation strategies that engage children, youth, families, and communities in evaluation and making meaning of data; data communication; and, support for data-driven learning and improvement at all levels - across fields of practices, for organizational leaders, program leaders, boards, funders, and frontline staff.

rows.business_description:
ARCHI-TECTONICS NYC, LLC - "Most Talk About Innovation; We DO Innovation"

Archi-Tectonics is an architectural design firm founded in 1994 by Winka Dubbeldam, with offices in New York City, Amsterdam/ the Netherlands, and Hangzhou/ China.

HOW WE THINK

We love to build. We operate at multiple scales of investigation, ranging from object design or architectural and building scale, to the planning of complex urban systems. Our methodology is deeply committed to research and extensive prototyping throughout all design stages. This analytical approach allows us to develop highly optimized, intelligent structures and morphologies, while promoting the emergence of a singular character and identity for each project.

The wide range of completed work worldwide is a testament to the strength of our research-based approach, and our ambition to create genuinely innovative typologies, spaces and materials, as well as uniquely evocative and transformative environments - Architecture that matters.

Our focus is not on style or a recognizable “signature” but on a process that combines creativity with technological advancements, resulting in what we call “poetic precision". We value performance over form, design intelligence over style.

We create great value for our clients and users, by providing efficient, sustainable, and at the same time strikingly beautiful solutions, often prominently enhancing the brand identity of our commercial clients. All our projects have proven to multiply the Return on Investment already at the time of completion. 

We are convinced that sustainability is an indisputable obligation to the world we live in, but also a great engine for innovation. Archi-Tectonics is an expert in LEED design and we are passionate about the use of smart systems and sustainable materials to create energy efficient, healthy living environments. 


HOW WE WORK

While intuition and skill remain at the core of our design process, we supplant and supplement this knowledge with advanced digital form-generating and prototyping tools, merging into what we consider Digital Craft.  This methodology allows us to expand beyond accepted architectural convention, opening the possibility of genuine innovation and discovery, while benefiting from the extensive construction knowledge we have developed over the years.

Our work occupies a space between machine-like intelligence and organic embodiment. We like to think that our designs have “character”,  an identity that helps brand our client’s company concept, as well as create resale value. We are proud that our clients typically report a multiple return on investment (200 -300%).

Everything is handmade from scratch in small batches, using the best ingredients we can get our hands on, and we never use any artificial flavorings or colorings. We carefully source our ingredients and work closely with farmers in NY and nearby to get our delicious organic dairy, seasonal fruits, and herbs. Other ingredients that simply don’t grow or can’t be found around New York like the Mexican vanilla bean, Oaxacan chocolate, tamarind, some dried chiles, passion fruit and hibiscus are imported, but we spend a lot of time and care making sure we get the best ingredients available and work with small producers in Mexico as we believe it’s very important to support them as well.
From the beginning, we have been committed to social and environmental responsibility and continuously strive to become a waste-free company. We compost our scraps, use recycled containers and napkins, and source much of our packaging locally. We are also very proud to support a wonderful organization like Fundación Crea, No Kid Hungry, City Harvest, Edible Schoolyard, Meals on Wheels, amongst others, and donate a portion of our sales to them whenever possible.
Crea helps generate employment opportunities in Mexico for low-income women. These women are amazing and a continuous inspiration.
To put it simply, the heart and mission of La Newyorkina is to share the sweetness of México.

Rios Interiors is proud to be one of the most trusted painting and remodeling companies in New York City. We offer our clients a wide array of services, including painting and decorative finishes, crown and base molding installation, marble and stone restoration, Finish carpentry services, bathroom and kitchen remodeling. Rios is your one-stop shop for residential and commercial renovation.

We might be well known now, yet Rios Interiors did not start that way. Before Jonathan established Rios Interiors Corp., as a teenager, he worked at his father’s painting company on weekends and during the summer. During that time, he learned the painting trade along with carpentry, wallpaper installation, and decorative plaster finishing.

By learning different trades and a little about business ownership from his father, Jonathan developed a true vision and desire to own his own construction company one day. Understanding that there was much to learn about successfully owning and operating a business, after graduating from high school, he attended Queens College with a Major in Economics.

With his extensive and practical hands-on experience while working for his father and his college education (focusing on economics), Jonathan was ready to take his entrepreneurial spirit and commence a journey toward his vision.

Jonathan took the leap and launched Rios Interiors Corp. in 2009. Equipped with a team whose combined experience is well over 20 years, he has created a quality that’s become synonymous with the brand of Rios Interiors.

Jonathan is known for regularly walking a site, and Rios Interiors takes personal responsibility for ensuring exceptional service and quality.

BAM Digital Media LLC - Digital Literacy Education & Workforce Development

BAM Digital Media LLC is a certified NYC & NYS MWBE specializing in algorithm literacy education, digital safety training, and technology workforce development for youth, parents, educators, seniors, and city employees. As an approved NYC DOE vendor, we deliver evidence-based curriculum that equips communities with critical digital competencies for the modern economy.
Core Services for Government Agencies:

Youth Programming & Violence Prevention

After-school digital literacy programs meeting DYCD standards
Algorithm literacy workshops addressing cyberbullying, online exploitation, and digital manipulation
Technology workforce readiness training for middle and high school students
Digital citizenship curriculum aligned with SEL frameworks
Summer youth employment digital skills training

Professional Development & Workforce Training

Educator professional development on digital safety and instructional technology
City employee training on social media policy, digital communication, and cybersecurity awareness
Workforce development programs for underserved populations entering tech careers
Train-the-trainer certification programs for community-based organizations

Senior & Older Adult Programming

Digital literacy training for seniors navigating smartphones, tablets, and computers
Fraud prevention and online scam protection workshops
Telehealth and digital healthcare platform training
Social connection through technology programs combating isolation
Financial technology and digital banking safety for older adults
Aging-in-place technology education for independent living

Parent & Community Engagement

Parent workshops on internet safety, screen time management, and platform literacy
Community education sessions on digital rights, privacy protection, and online safety
Multilingual family technology workshops
Digital inclusion programming for libraries and community centers

Curriculum Development & Consulting

Custom digital literacy curriculum design for schools and agencies
Program evaluation and outcomes measurement for technology initiatives
Digital safety policy development and implementation support
Technical assistance for community technology programs

Our Proprietary PILLARS Framework addresses five critical competencies: Awareness (understanding algorithmic manipulation), Safety (protecting personal information and wellbeing), Agency (making informed digital choices), and Application (using technology strategically). This evidence-based approach has been implemented across NYC public schools, libraries, and community organizations, adapted for all age groups from elementary students to older adults.
Unique Qualifications:

14 years digital marketing experience with Fortune 500 brands (Disney, Netflix, Amazon, P&G)
Insider knowledge of platform algorithms and engagement tactics
NYC public school parent and former PTA President with deep community trust
Master of Public Administration degree
Proven track record delivering programs through NYC DOE, BPL, and DOHMH partnerships

Target Populations:
K-12 students, parents and caregivers, educators and school staff, city employees, older adults and seniors, justice-involved youth, foster care populations, immigrant families, workforce development participants, community-based organization staff
Service Delivery:
In-person and virtual workshops, ongoing after-school programs, professional development series, train-the-trainer programs, curriculum licensing, technical assistance, program consulting, senior center programming, NORC (Naturally Occurring Retirement Community) workshops

rows.business_description:
Jamrock Jerk LLC is a leading multi-unit mobile food service operator based in New York City, specializing in authentic Jamaican cuisine while also offering a wide variety of wholesome, culturally diverse meals. Founded in 2016, we have grown from a single cart into one of the city’s most recognized mobile food operators, with a fleet of licensed food trucks/food carts supported by our own 17,000 sq. ft. commissary and catering facility in Jamaica, Queens.

Our operations are built to serve New York at scale. Each food truck can serve 500–1,000 meals per day, and our commissary facility operates nearly around the clock, strategically located with direct access to major highways. This allows us to mobilize quickly and reach neighborhoods throughout the city within an hour, providing reliable service during seasonal operations and special events.

While our foundation is rooted in authentic Jamaican jerk cuisine, our kitchens are fully equipped to produce diverse menus that meet the needs of New York’s communities, including halal, kosher, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. rows.business_description:
SeniorHabitat is a two-sided marketplace with interactive and customized tools. We use proprietary smart algorithms to connect family caregivers with care providers. We maximize the ability for older adults to age in their community and avoid re-hospitalizations.

SeniorHabitat was created because 87% of caregivers are unaware of resources that can help them make critical decisions and provide proper care.  Although the United States is one of the most advanced country when it comes to medicine, it is still struggling with providing high-quality care to older adults. Rather than providing high-quality care, services is often delivered by many different providers without coordination. As a result, many older adults aren't getting their needs met and caregivers are struggling with their growing responsibilities. Rather than having caregivers feel ‘left in the lurch’ and having to “battle the system,” SeniorHabitat empowers care connections by using technology to improve continuity of care and provide better access to support services. It serves the individual needs of older adults through interactive, intelligent-driven care solutions. To improve quality of life for older adults, SeniorHabitat created a platform that provides support and guidance to stressed family caregivers by offering objective and qualified solutions for the following social determinants of health: 1) Resources to meet daily needs (ex. housing & nutrition), 2) Access to health care services, 3) Community-based resources (ex. care management), 4) Social & legal support, 5) Opportunities for recreational & leisure activities (ex. adult day & senior centers), 6) Transportation options. Our mission is to improve the quality of life (QoL) for older adults by enabling access to a comprehensive network of care providers and services.

The scale of the studio enables us to undertake complex projects while keeping Florian and Jing closely engaged throughout. Both principals are actively involved in teaching and research, fostering a dynamic exchange between practice and academia that keeps the work curious, critical, and forward-looking. rows.business_description:
Actor Lynne Lambert had the idea for NYC SUBWAY LINE in 1995.  While waiting for a subway at Boro Hall, Brooklyn, she looked up at the subway sign with its big, green #4 and #5 circles and thought how these familiar generic circles with their numbers and letters, were like the wallpaper of The City.  With a son turning five years old, it occurred to Lynne that if there were a #5 train tee shirt, she would have a great birthday gift for all of her son's friends who would also be turning five that year.  Or, an #A train tee for Ali, #R for Rory, and so forth. Lynne thought the subways should be wearable, and contacted the MTA to obtain a license to do just that!  Prak Productions, Inc has had the MTA license for 24 years now.  The company first shipped in November of 1996.  Prak customers, such as Macys, Museum of the City of New York, The City Store, Top of the Rock, F.A.O. Schwarz, the NY Transit Museum stores and others, inspired Lynne to add in hats, bags, backpacks, travel accessories and many other items to the product line as the years went by. Always a favorite of both tourists and New Yorkers who love NYC, these NYC Subway Line items have been worn by celebrities, featured in magazines, newspapers and used as wardrobe in movies, TV and music videos.  Lynne’s unique business story has also been told on Donny Deutch’s “The Big Idea,” CBS News, “Bagels and Broadway” and WOR radio shows as well as in many print articles.  Prak's current array of products can be viewed at www.NYCSubwayLine.net.

Over the years, Prak had been asked to make similar products for other locales.  The most requested imagery was maps.  Buyers wanted products with maps of their own transit system, town, state or city.  Lynne decided there would be a good business making promotional products with maps on them.  Launching in 2018, Prak's new brand, MAP'T GEAR, offers something truly unique in the world of corporate gifts, employee appreciation gifts and event giveaways.  Instead of producing products with a mere company logo, MAP'T GEAR creates products which feature a company's location, the location of one or all its outposts, or of its meeting on a decorative, completely customized map.  MAP'T GEAR's current product line of messenger bags, padfolios, tees, drinkware and totes are handsome items which will actually be used or worn, unlike the majority of promotional gift items which are often tossed or donated as unwanted company advertisements.  Prak made totes for NY State’s Small Business Development Center’s 2018 conference. Prak can also make custom products which include NYC Subway maps and signs.  These and other Map't Gear products, viewable at www.MAP'TGEAR.com

Black House Group Inc. is a women and minority owned event production agency founded by two college besties who share a passion for producing events and curating experiences.  Our full service event production agency can manage all aspects of  your event, or provide specific services in collaboration with your event planning team.  We specialize event management, technical direction, brand activations, set design, stage management, and onsite production support.

DIVERSE EXPERTISE 
We not only celebrate diversity we seek it. Our boutique agency operates with a small full time team and a vast extended tribe working on contracts matched to each event based on experience.  We live for our craft and seek out others who invest the same passion and energy into their work as we do. We flex our team – up and down – as needed to ensure that we bring the right experience at the right time to maximize your budget. Our rigorous process and extensive network of event professionals affords our clients with access to the best-in-the-biz all coordinated under one vision – one plan. We grind in the background and enable you to focus on your attendees, clients, press and sponsors.


AUTHENTIC COLLABORATION
Strong communication is one of our hallmarks and it begins with listening.  You call us for reason, and we take the time to talk over all your desires and fears to learn precisely what we can provide to help you succeed. We work back from a BIG picture to ensure all possible costs are accounted for.  To begin, we delve into your mission and vision for the event so that we can align our creative plan to your brand and ethos of your organization’s culture. We take the time to understand what makes you authentically… you. We learn your event objectives and pinpoint potential road-blocks in the event production.  

PRECISE BUDGETING 
Fiscal responsibility is at the forefront of all our projects. Mindful budget planning and financial discipline ensures no overages. Once we establish a budget, we are limited only by our imagination. 

BESPOKE EXPERIENCES 
Our designers craft ways to visualize your message and engage guests in experiences that depict your mission. We turn four blank walls into memorable, immersive experiences. Together we will create the environment and experience you envision.

TECHNOLOGY DRIVEN 
Our forward thinking tribe of designers and producers utilize technology and innovative solutions scaled to your budget to make your event unique.  

STAGE DESIGN 
Our trendsetting designers will set the tone of your event with custom stage designs and captivating scenic installations. 

STAGE MANAGEMENT 
Our skilled stage management team runs smooth and stress-free programs and shows.  Whether it is simple remarks on a small stage, or a full blown concert - we will make sure everything is executed on schedule as planned.  

STREAMLINED SERVICES 
Let us streamline event production services to make your life simpler!  We can manage all aspects of your event, or provide a single service such as technical direction and drafting.  Our team will assist wherever you need a hand, and will take lead on the elements you would like to “off-load”. 

EVENT MANAGEMENT 
Our team will manage all the moving pieces onsite and allow you to stay focused on your attendees. Each event builds on a deep foundation of learning from past events. We present a formal recap to provide meaningful lessons for your future events.

rows.business_description:
Elle Rouge LLC is a certified Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (MWBE) providing innovative solutions in digital storytelling, social media strategy, professional development, and event production with a focus on educational institutions and community organizations. Our work centers on helping schools, districts, and nonprofits strengthen their digital voice, authentically tell their stories, and deepen trust with families and communities. With over two decades of combined expertise in events, marketing, branding, and content creation, Elle Rouge brings a unique blend of creativity, cultural responsiveness, and technical skill to every engagement.

Our social media storytelling services help schools develop strategies that highlight student achievement, school culture, and community partnerships. We design content tailored for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube, producing branded visuals, short-form videos, and campaigns that capture authentic moments and build family engagement. We also provide content calendars, social media audits, and performance analytics that help schools translate online visibility into stronger connections with their communities.

In addition to digital storytelling, Elle Rouge LLC offers full-scale support for virtual and hybrid event production. From conferences and professional development days to parent workshops, town halls, and student showcases, we provide event branding, platform management, live streaming, registration systems, and post-event reporting. These services allow schools and districts to extend their reach, increase participation, and ensure events reflect the professionalism and pride of their communities.

Recognizing the growing need for capacity building within schools, we design and deliver professional development tailored to Parent Coordinators, Community School Directors, and school staff who oversee digital communications. Our trainings are hands-on and practical, covering how to capture privacy-safe but powerful content, take engaging photos and short videos, create posts that “stop the scroll,” and integrate AI tools that make content creation faster and more consistent. We also provide customized toolkits, such as the Respect & Trust Messaging Toolkit, which equips schools with editable Canva templates for back-to-school messages, holiday greetings, and parent engagement reminders.

Elle Rouge LLC also supports family and community engagement campaigns that go beyond traditional methods of communication. We design bilingual and culturally responsive messaging strategies that reflect the identity of the school community and amplify student voices. Our storytelling approach strengthens family trust, increases transparency, and ensures that the values of the school are consistently represented. Beyond staff training, we also connect this work to workforce readiness by introducing students to digital storytelling as a viable career pathway aligned with Career and Technical Education (CTE).

Our proven impact can be seen in partnerships with the New York City Department of Education Office of Community Schools, Village Academy, Bronx Community Schools, and PS 287 Global Innovators. Through these collaborations, schools have reported measurable increases in family engagement, stronger alignment between digital presence and school culture, and significant growth in online reach. For example, campaigns we designed have consistently delivered engagement rates well above industry benchmarks, showing how effective storytelling can transform school-to-family communication.

Led by a former NYC DOE Parent Coordinator who supported a successful “turnaround” school, Elle Rouge LLC combines deep knowledge of school systems with professional expertise in branding and digital engagement. This perspective allows us to understand the challenges school leaders face while providing strategies that are practical, sustainable, and impactful.

Elle Rouge LLC remains committed to helping educational institutions and community organizations harness the power of digital platforms to tell their stories, build trust, and strengthen the relationships that support student success. As an MWBE-certified company, we continue to expand our services and impact while maintaining the highest standards of accountability and cultural competence.
